body.name: simultaneous orientation rule and confidence set
body.construction: Fix the unique \(\widehat m\in\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\). With \(x_\alpha=\log(8/\alpha)\) and the corresponding simultaneous threshold \(u_{d,\alpha}=x_\alpha+\log(2d)\), use the four-rotation cross-fitted squared-risk estimates for \(q_{j,b}\) and the intervals delivered by \(\widehat H^\perp_{j,b}(\widehat m)\) for all \((j,b)\in\mathcal Q_d\). Let \(B_j\subseteq\{-1,+1\}\) contain \(b\) exactly when its residual-HSIC interval contains \(0\), the interval for \(-b\) intersects \([\lambda,\infty)\), and the lower confidence bound for \(s_{j,b}-s_{j,-b}\) is nonnegative; replace an empty \(B_j\) by \(\{-1,+1\}\). Set \(\widehat{\mathcal C}_n=\prod_{j\in I}B_j\), and let \(\widehat\theta_n\) be its unique element when it is a singleton and a fixed measurable element otherwise.
